title: A/P Summary: a link naming several locations or every location
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open A/P documents at three locations, {Location-A}, {Location-B} and {Location-C}, and you are enrolled at all three.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Starting screen: A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Location menu, untick {Location-C}.
  2. In the address bar, replace the two "locationIds=" entries with one: "locationIds=" followed by the two codes separated by a comma.
  3. Press Enter.
  4. In the Location menu, click "Select all".
  5. Untick {Location-A}.
  6. Untick {Location-B}.
  7. In the address bar, replace {Location-C}'s code with the three codes separated by commas: {Location-A}'s and {Location-B}'s (noted in step 1), then {Location-C}'s.
  8. Press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the report narrows to {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and the page address carries the two ticked locations as two "locationIds=" entries, each followed by a long code (the location's code, not its name). Note the two codes.
  • Step 2: the address bar shows one "locationIds=" entry with the two codes separated by a comma.
  • Step 3: the link listing locations separated by commas opens the report with those two ticked ("Location: 2 locations").
  • Step 4: every location is ticked and the address no longer lists locations.
  • Step 5: {Location-A} is unticked.
  • Step 6: only {Location-C} is ticked, and the address holds one "locationIds=" entry: {Location-C}'s code.
  • Step 7: the address bar shows the three codes separated by commas.
  • Step 8: a link naming every location opens as "Location: All locations".

The tester edits only the location part of the page address. Shortened 22 Oct 2026 (Rule 136): the address is edited in the same tab, which opens it as a link; a link opened in a new tab is checked in the reload, Back and shared-link case of A/R Collection.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R10: “The ticked locations are kept in the page address while fewer than all are ticked, so browser Back, a reload and a shared link restore them; a link listing several locations separated by commas is read as those locations. "No locations" is not kept in the address: a reload or shared link opens on All locations, as on Sales By Customer. A link naming every location reads as All locations.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §3 D30: “URL keys asOfDate, customerIds / vendorIds, pastDue, locationIds (repeated keys written, comma lists also read); legacy customerId / vendorId read once as aliases.”
